move. Try again and look for a strong forcing option.] [%hint Find a strong
capture.]} (7. Qa4+ $2 Nd7 {Black blocks the check and develops. Try again and
look for a stronger attacking idea.}) (7. Qb3 $2 Qb6 {Black defends b7 and e6
with an OK game. Try again and look for a stronger attacking idea.}) 7... fxe6
{Nice move! How should you continue the attack?} 8. Qh5+ {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try again and look for a good check.] [%hint Find a strong
check.]} (8. Qf3 $2 Nf6 {Black defends against checkmate and White has no
advantage. Try again and look for a stronger queen move.}) (8. Qb3 $2 Qb6 {
Black defends b7 and e6. Try again and look for a stronger queen move.}) (8.
Qa4+ $2 Nd7 {Black defends with an OK position. Try again and look for a
stronger check.}) 8... g6 {Black can only temporarily halt White's initiative.
What's next?} 9. Nxg6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
way to open lines toward the black king.] [%hint The h7-pawn is pinned and
doesn't really defend g6.]} (9. Qh3 $5 {White is doing well, but there's a
stronger move. Try to find a way to win material.}) (9. Qf3 $2 Qc7 {Black
defends every weakness and attacks the e5-knight. Try again and look for a
stronger attacking idea.}) 9... hxg6 {Good idea! What should you capture?} 10.
Qxh8 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to win
material.] [%hint Capture a rook.] Great job!} (10. Qxg6+ $2 Kd7 {White
doesn't have enough compensation for the sacrificed material. Try again and
look for a stronger capture.}) *

{What is the one safe developing move for Black?} 5... Bb4+ {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Develop
your bishop with check.]} (5... Nf6 $2 6. Qb3 {Even Garry Kasparov has played
this but he ran into immediate trouble with his f7-pawn. Try again and look
for a better developing move.}) (5... dxe3 $2 6. Bxf7+ {Black's king can't
recapture without losing the queen! Try again and look for a stronger forcing
option.}) (5... Bd6 $2 6. O-O {White has a dangerous initiative. Try again and
look for a more forcing bishop move.}) (5... Be7 $2 6. Qb3 {White has a
dangerous initiative. Try again and look for a more forcing bishop move.}) (
5... Bc5 $2 6. Qb3 {White has a dangerous initiative. Try again and look for a
more forcing bishop move.}) (5... Be6 $2 6. Bxe6 {After fxe6 Black's king is
exposed. Try again and look for a better move with the other bishop.}) 6. Bd2 {
Good choice! What's the safest way to continue?} Bxd2+ {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Trade bishops.]
Nicely done! Black is ready to play Nf6 and castle, with a safe position.
White will win back the pawn on d4 and the game will be roughly even.} (6... a5
$2 7. Qb3 {Whtie has a dangerous initiative, attacking b4 and f7. Try again
and look for a strong capture.}) (6... Qe7 $2 7. O-O {Black may run into
trouble with the king and queen lined up on the e-file. Try again and look for
a strong capture.}) (6... Nc6 $2 7. Bxb4 {After Nxb4 and Qa4+ White has a
strong attack. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) *

{How should White take advantage of Black's mistake in the opening?} 6. Qb3 {

diagonal. ]} (6. exd4 $2 Bd6 {Black is OK in the balanced isolated pawn
position. Try again and look for a way to make a strong threat.}) (6. Nxd4 $2
Bd6 {Black is OK in the balanced position. Try again and look for a way to
make a powerful threat.}) (6. Qxd4 $2 Qxd4 {Black is OK in the endgame. Try
again and look for a way to make a powerful threat.}) (6. Ng5 $2 Bb4+ {Black
prepares to castle and White lags in development. Try to find a stronger way
to target f7.}) (6. Ne5 $2 Bb4+ {Black prepares to castle and White lags in
development. Try to find a stronger way to target f7.}) 6... Qe7 {Great move!
What did GM Mamedyarov play to convince former world champion,
Kasparov to resign?} 7. O-O {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and
look for the best way to take advantage of Black's poorly placed queen on e7.]
[%hint Secure your king and prepare to bring a rook to the e-file.] Great job!
Black resigned in Mamedyarov - Kasparov, 2021. We will examine a possible
continuation in the next challenge.} (7. Ng5 $2 Qb4+ {Black forces a queen
trade and survives the attack. Try again and look for a stronger option.}) (7.

way to take advantage of the soon-to-open e-file.}) *

option, but there's an even better capture. Try to find it.}) 1-0
